_about: Shared prompt for the Pocket Garden Lounge sprites, painted with ElevenLabs (model recraft-v4.1-flash, 16:9, one generation each) from each character's portrait.subject in its avatar/avatar.json, or its own sprite.subject where the portrait's wording doesn't suit a full-body sprite (sitting on something, floating copies, a head only). Characters with green in them are painted on magenta so the key doesn't eat them. dev/make-sprites.py turns each painting into avatar/sprite.png (5 facings x 3 walk frames). See docs/generic/avatars.md.
style: 16-bit pixel art JRPG character turnaround sheet, SNES overworld sprite style, chibi, about 2.5 heads tall. Character: {subject}. Five full-body standing views of this same character in one horizontal row, evenly spaced, same size, feet level, gaps between them. Left to right: front view; three-quarter front view turned right; right side profile; three-quarter back view; back view. Crisp pixels, dark outline, simple cel shading. Flat solid {bg} background, no shadows, no text.
